purpose: Decide which useful resources attract qualified discovery and lead to real adoption.
existingIntegration: Portfolio analytics source exists; runtime, account configuration and coverage are not verified by this plan.
reviewCadence: Compare complete matched 28-day windows; inspect failures weekly; disclose releases, seasonality and consent coverage.

metrics.definition: Sum clicks for disclosed search queries classified non-brand using a versioned brand-query rule. Do not describe this as all organic clicks.
metrics.source: Owner Google Search Console export; keep Bing in a separate series
metrics.grain: day x landing page x search type, with available query classification
metrics.limitation: Withheld queries, aggregation, reporting windows and country/device mix affect coverage. No platform-specific AI attribution without an actual supported report.

metrics.definition: Observed consented landing sessions containing dataset_download_click, template_download_click or repository_open, divided by observed consented landing sessions in the same cohort. Zero denominator produces null.
metrics.source: Owner analytics export after event instrumentation is verified
metrics.grain: 28-day window x landing page x source group
metrics.limitation: Clicks are intent proxies, not successful transfers, installations or citations. Consent-limited sessions are not all visitors.

metrics.definition: Distinct independently maintained projects with a reviewed public implementation or permissioned evidence of actual use. Exclude the maintainer's reference sites and unverified claims.
metrics.source: Reviewed adoption ledger with evidence URLs and dates
metrics.limitation: Voluntary reporting undercounts adoption. Repository stars, downloads and owner-controlled examples are not independent adoption.

dimensionPolicy: Use publisher-controlled enumerations, not free text or raw URLs. Do not send user-submitted audit targets.

guardrails.target: No unauthorized collection or personal-data payloads
guardrails.verification: Browser network/storage test before consent, after acceptance, rejection and revocation; inspect actual requests.

guardrails.target: No broken linked downloads or mismatched dataset descriptions
guardrails.verification: Local parity checks plus deployed HTTP/content-type and download verification.

ownerGates: Verify the existing provider account and page coverage
Set and document retention and privacy notice
Instrument events without duplicate page views
Export aggregate baseline data before making growth claims
